name: crowell_feasibility

231.role: fallback, named in prereg §2 before any read

label_is_histological: REF/TVA/CRC are pathologist-drawn shapes over H&E, not a function of any transcript, so the label cannot be circular with respect to GUCA2A. That is why this deposit is worth the time — see the Becker prereg RESULT for what a transcript label costs.
floor_is_per_probe: mean over control probes of each probe's own detection rate. The union over all probes is reported separately as a contamination indicator and is NOT the comparable floor.
does_not_license: any per-cell 'GUCA2A-low = silenced' claim. The false-negative rate is unmeasured here as everywhere else (§6g).
amendments: Amendment 1 — floor, obs controls, ACTB absent, the §2 fallback DEVIATION, below-quantification not censored
Amendment 2 — verdict decomposed into fields; control-referenced pattern is exploratory

verdict.verdict: TARGET BELOW THE ADENOMA USABILITY BAR — PER-CELL READING NOT LICENSED; DIRECTIONAL READ SUPPORTIVE, NOT CONFIRMATORY
verdict.detail: GUCA2A clears the bar in ['231_REF'] and sits BELOW it in '231_TVA' (+0.700 against +1.099). **Below the limit of quantification, NOT censored** — the bar is analyst-chosen (Amendment 1 §6), and nothing here builds a background-adjusted bound. **The per-cell spatial reading is NOT licensed.** §6's pre-specified direction: GUCA2A +1.571 in '231_REF' -> +0.700 in '231_TVA' — a FALL, which §6 fixed in advance as the safe direction because a field-affected reference understates it. Global capture in '231_TVA' is not worse than in '231_REF', over 1 control-role gene(s). **That is global capture only. It does not establish GUCA2A-specific sensitivity or any false-negative rate** (prereg §7), and with ACTB absent it rests on one gene (Amendment 1 §3). n = 1 patient(s). Supportive, NOT confirmatory.
